description: Defines a React functional component named EmptyState for displaying a friendly message when there is no content to show. It accepts props for title, optional description, and optional action elements, rendering a styled container with an icon, title, optional description, and optional action.

methods.name: EmptyState({ title, description, action })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a stylized message box with an icon, title, optional description, and optional action.
